policy: Only original CL2 historical_row IDs count as source-review progress
An official standing schedule is not a date-specific Mass occurrence
Do not assume SSPX operates an associated Carmelite, Clarisse, Dominican, Franciscan or Capuchin house
Retain exceptions for months, school holidays, first Saturdays, saint feasts and operator change
Never convert confession, exposition, Vespers or procession into Mass
No changes to production Atlas, GPS, historical source identities, canonical status, una-cum, or published Mass events
